resizebox 复杂表格被 quarto 接管后的命运。\ref{tbl-resize}。

```{=latex}
\begin{table*}[h]
\centering
\caption{resizebox 组合表}
\label{tbl-resize}
\resizebox{1.12\textwidth}{!}{
\begin{minipage}{0.33\textwidth}
\begin{tabular}{ll}
\hline
A & B \\
1 & 2 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{minipage}
\begin{minipage}{0.33\textwidth}
\begin{tabular}{ll}
\hline
C & D \\
3 & 4 \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
\end{minipage}
}
\end{table*}
```
